header.contentDescription: Drag to send P and S rays through a wireframe Earth, with the S rays dying at the liquid outer core

drawTextAnchored.text: 4 of every 13 rays on each side never arrive
a push-pull along the ray - gases, liquids and solids all carry it
a sideways shear, and a liquid has nothing to shear against
the red rays stopped where the core begins
drag to send the wavefront out
Nobody has been below 12 km. The shadow is how the core was found,
by Richard Oldham in 1906 and Inge Lehmann in 1936.
